verdict.rationale: GitLab explicitly documents recommended reference architectures for scaling self-hosted installations (gitlab-docs-11) and supports cloud-native scaling via Helm chart/Operator (gitlab-docs-16), directly matching the story's self-hosting scale theme. Missing for 10: explicit mention of specific user-count tiers (e.g., 'up to 50k users') or independent/hands-on validation that these architectures actually scale to tens of thousands of users; community evidence only discusses unrelated SaaS performance/backup issues, not self-hosted reference-architecture scaling.
